plain_english_policy: This bill is purely ceremonial. It does not change infrastructure policy, funding rules, or energy regulations. Its only effect is to rename a specific stretch of Alabama Highway 9 in Cherokee County after W.A. (Dub) Ellis, Jr., and to instruct officials to install signs for the new name.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce no substantive policy shift other than an official change in signage and public designation within a single county. There are no implications for infrastructure spending, energy production, or statewide transportation planning beyond this local naming convention.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Lindsey advanced the bill to rename a highway segment; no further policy positions are inferred from sponsorship.
evidence_quotes: "NAMING ALABAMA HIGHWAY 9 FROM COUNTY ROAD 14 TO COUNTY ROAD 128 IN CHEROKEE COUNTY 'THE W.A. (DUB) ELLIS, JR. HIGHWAY.'"
"That Alabama Highway 9 from County Road 14 to County Road 128 in Cherokee County is named 'The W.A. 'Dub' Ellis, Jr. Highway.'"
